Jordan Lee: Quick question 1	6 — my calendar shows two entries for the same "New Hire Orientation: Day 1" slot: one is a 1h event at 09:00 and another is a 3h all-day placeholder. Which should I keep?
Priya Singh: Hey @Jordan, keep the timed event (09:00). The all-day one is a legacy placeholder we accidentally synced from the admission system.
Jordan Lee: Ah, thanks. I'm on Outlook and it auto-accepted both, now my day looks blocked. Can I remove the placeholder without messing up invites?
Sophie Kim: You can decline the all-day placeholder and it won't notify hosts. On Outlook: open event > "Respond" > "Decline" > uncheck "Send response". That clears your calendar only.
Jordan Lee: Nice, that worked. For other folks on GCal: any easier way?
Priya Singh: On Google Calendar accept the event labeled "(local)" and delete the one that says "Onboarding placeholder". We will update titles in the source so it's clearer for next cohort.
Sophie Kim: Also FYI: if your client auto-adds invites (Outlook auto-accept), toggle Settings > Calendar > Auto-accept/decline. Admins can turn it off org-wide if too many people hit this.
Jordan Lee: Thanks 64b. One more: where do recordings land? The invite has a Zoom cloud note but no link.
Onboard Bot: @channel Recordings flow: Zoom cloud -> queued -> copied to onboarding S3 -> short-lived presigned link posted in this thread (~15-60m) -> archived to Onboarding Notion page (view-only) within 48h. If you lack Drive access we post the Notion link which is team-viewable.
Priya Singh: We realized earlier that some recordings ended up only in Zoom for orgs that require passcodes. If you get a passcode prompt, reply here and Calendar Team will issue a temporary pre-signed link.
Calendar Team: Quick note for admins: export ICSs without the duplicate placeholder by using the export flag `--exclude=placeholders` on the sync tool. Example: `./calendar-sync --export 2026-03 --exclude=placeholders`. We'll push an update to the scheduler tonight.
Jordan Lee: Perfect. Can someone ping me when the scheduler is fixed? I'm 2hrs behind the PST cohort and want clean invites.
Sophie Kim: Will do. We'll post status here when deployed.
Onboard Bot: Deployment scheduled: calendar-sync v2.18 -> staging 03/24 02:00 UTC, prod 03/25 02:00 UTC. Notifying @new-hires when live.
Jordan Lee: Amazing, thanks everyone!
